label: Yaracuy Foreshock Epicenter (M7.2)
sub: 20km E of San Felipe; 10km depth; strike-slip

label: La Guaira Mainshock Epicenter (M7.5)
sub: 20km W of Catia La Mar; 10km depth; offshore rupture

label: Catia La Mar Children's Hospital (Collapsed)
sub: 16 children killed, 35 injured when the hospital building collapsed

label: Caraballeda Transitional Camp
sub: Among La Guaira's largest shelter sites; a nearby McDonald's was converted into a field hospital

label: La Guaira Shelter Network (26 sites)
sub: 8,600+ displaced people housed across 26 emergency shelters

label: Caracas Shelter Network (39 sites)
sub: 11,100-person capacity across 39 shelters citywide; roughly 5,000 occupied

label: Miranda State Shelters (22 sites)
sub: 1,060 displaced people sheltered across 22 sites

label: Simón Bolívar Intl Airport (Maiquetía)
sub: Heavily damaged; all flights canceled in the immediate aftermath

label: Caracas Metro (Suspended)
sub: Services suspended indefinitely following the quakes

label: Altamira District Building Collapses
sub: 3 buildings collapsed incl. a 22-story tower; ~30 buildings heavily damaged

label: Chacao Municipality Damage
sub: 58 killed, 26 rescued; roughly 100 buildings damaged

label: La Guaira Port (Makeshift Mortuary)
sub: Converted to a temporary mortuary processing roughly 400 bodies/day at peak

label: Venezuelan Red Cross Headquarters
sub: Severely damaged in the earthquake

label: Caraballeda Bridge (Collapsed)
sub: Key bridge connecting Caraballeda to the rest of La Guaira collapsed in a June 26 aftershock

label: Ana Victoria Housing Complex (Vargas)
sub: First 60 rehabilitated apartments delivered under the nationwide home-repair program

label: Carabobo State Damage (Valencia area)
sub: 568 homes destroyed, 787 damaged; 19 deaths, 67 injured statewide

label: Puerto Cabello Hospitals
sub: 40+ people treated for quake-related injuries

label: Bosque Lindo Housing Complex (Aragua)
sub: Complex collapse caused multiple deaths; part of 18+ deaths statewide

label: La Mar Suites, Tucacas (Falcón)
sub: 12 dead, 33 injured in hotel collapse

label: Boca de Aroa (Falcón)
sub: 87 homes damaged; 252 residents affected

label: Veroes Municipality (Yaracuy)
sub: 25 homes collapsed, 35 badly damaged of ~3,000 inspected

label: WFP / World Vision Aid Distribution Point
sub: Hot meals, emergency food, hygiene supplies and shelter kits distributed to displaced families
